map.E.164 是国际电信标准格式：+ 国家码 + 国内号码（不含分隔符与首位 0）: E.164 is the international telecommunications standard format: + country code + national number (without separators or a leading 0).
map.本工具为轻量格式化（按位分组），不校验号段有效性；严格校验请用 libphone: This tool does lightweight formatting (grouping by digit position) and does not validate numbering plan rules; for strict validation use a service such as libphonenumber.
map.若原号码已含国家码，请选择对应国家再粘贴纯数字。: If the original number already includes a country code, select the matching country and paste only the digits.
map.提示：很多国家国内号码首位为 0（如英国 0xxxx），写入 E.164 时需去: Note: in many countries the national number starts with 0 (e.g. 0xxxx in the United Kingdom), and that 0 must be dropped when writing E.164.

map.清洗导入的用户手机号：统一成 E.164（如 +8613800138000）再入: Cleanse imported user phone numbers: normalize to E.164 (e.g. +8613800138000) before storing, so that domestic numbers, 0-prefixed numbers and international numbers do not get mixed together.
map.国际电信标准 +国家码+号码，无空格。: The international telecommunications standard: + country code + number, with no spaces.
map.为什么有的号码解析失败？: Why do some numbers fail to parse?
map.常见原因：号码缺少国家码（无法判断归属）、包含了分隔符与分机号，或是虚拟运营商与: Common reasons: the number has no country code (so its origin cannot be determined), it contains separators and an extension, or it belongs to a virtual operator or a newly allocated range that is not catalogued yet. Chinese mobile numbers have 11 digits and start with 1; landline numbers need an area code. On failure, keep the original input and prompt the user to add a country code rather than discarding it.

map.结果拆分展示国家码、区号与用户号，便于国际呼叫、存储与校验；建议始终带国家区号以: The result is split into country code, area code and subscriber number for international dialing, storage and validation; always including the country code is recommended so that the number works across regions.
map.清洗：剔除非数字字符（空格、连字符、括号）\n国家码：优先用输入中的“+”前缀识:
Clean: strip non-digits (spaces, hyphens, parentheses)
Country code: detect from a leading "+" when present; otherwise use the selected region; strip a repeated country code from a pure-digit number when the remaining length is plausible
Trunk 0: remove the leading 0 for the UK, Japan, India, Taiwan (China) and Australia
E.164 = + country code + national number, 15 digits max
Validation: national-number length only (per selected country); operator prefixes are not validated
map.把粘贴进来的各种写法整理成 E.164，并按常见 3-4-4 / 4-4-4 规: Normalise pasted formats into E.164 and group them with common 3-4-4 / 4-4-4 rules, alongside a length-check result that turns red when the length is wrong.
map.解析范围：识别并剥离国家码、去掉国内首位 0；不解析区号归属地，也不判断运营商。: Scope: detect and strip the country code and leading trunk 0; area-code location and operator are not resolved.
map.显示：中国 11 位手机按 3-4-4 分组，其余按 4 位一组从右分组。: Display: 11-digit Chinese mobiles use 3-4-4; others are grouped in 4s from the right.
map.校验：只校验长度范围；号段/前缀是否真实存在需另用权威号码库。: Validation: length range only; whether a prefix really exists requires an authoritative number database.

map.本工具只实现简化分组：中国 11 位手机按 3-4-4，其余号码从右每 4 位一: This tool uses simplified grouping only: 11-digit Chinese mobiles use 3-4-4 and other numbers are grouped in 4s from the right; it does not implement full per-country dialing conventions.
map.本工具只做格式整理与长度校验：选中国家后，国内号码位数不在预设范围（如中国 10: This tool only normalises format and checks length: it flags failure when the national number is outside the preset range (e.g. 10-11 digits for China) or E.164 exceeds 15 digits. It does not verify that a number is in service and does not split area codes; paste landline numbers with their area code.
map.号码可直接粘贴“+86 138 0013 8000”，工具会按“+”前缀识别国家: You can paste "+86 138 0013 8000"; a leading "+" is used to detect the country code. Without "+", the selected region is used and duplicate country codes or the leading national 0 are stripped automatically.
map.清洗：剔除非数字字符（空格、连字符、括号）: Cleaning: remove non-digit characters (spaces, hyphens, parentheses)
map.国家码：优先用输入中的“+”前缀识别；否则用所选地区；若纯数字开头已含所选国家码: Country code: first recognized by a leading "+" in the input; otherwise the selected region is used; if a purely numeric number already starts with the selected country code and the remaining length is plausible, it is stripped automatically
map.国内首位 0：英国/日本/印度/中国台湾/澳大利亚等按规则去掉（trunk pr: Leading national 0: removed per rule for the UK/Japan/India/Taiwan/Australia etc. (trunk prefix)
map.E.164 = + 国家码 + 国内号码，总长 ≤15 位: E.164 = + country code + national number, total length ≤15 digits
map.校验：仅校验国内号码长度范围（按所选国家预设），不校验运营商号段: Validation: only the national number's length range is validated (per the selected country preset); carrier number blocks are not validated
